title: CondoGuard Rental Payment-History Multiplier
content:
Billing office rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy tying the unit rental charge to the policy's late fees.

**Rule.** The rental payment-history multiplier is 1.05 when a late fee was charged on the policy fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the endorsement, 0.97 when no late fee was charged within that time and the policy has been in force for 12 or more whole months, and 1.00 when no late fee was charged within that time and the policy has been in force for fewer than 12 whole months. The multiplier is applied to the sum of the tier's unit rental annual premium and the landlord liability load, before the full-year rental charge is rounded. Where that sum carries more than one rental multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the sum; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Entries read.** Late fee entries on the policy's premium account, by the date each was charged; and the policy's first inception date, counted in whole months to the day of the endorsement.

| Late fee charged in the 12 whole months before the endorsement | Whole months in force | Rental payment-history multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 1.05 |
| no | 12 or more | 0.97 |
| no | fewer than 12 | 1.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- A late fee charged 11 whole months before the day of the endorsement: 1.05.
- The only late fee was charged 12 whole months before: not within the time, and a policy in force 30 whole months gives 0.97.
- No late fee ever and a policy in force 11 whole months: 1.00; in force 12 whole months: 0.97.
